summary: strip_curtain / walk-in cooler strip curtain: wrong_scale

findings.description: The caption states 6 leaves of 0.400 x 2.380 x 0.002 m in strip_curtain and a total of 3.5 kg. The stated area density is 2.5 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 14 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 6. Every leaf is 6x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2
